items.prompt: All other fields pass. Which price text is accepted by this task, including its rule for leading zeros?

options.why: Price permits leading zeros, is positive, and has one fractional digit, within the four-digit limit.
A decimal point must be followed by one to four digits. A trailing point is not accepted.
Exponent notation is not part of this task grammar even though another numeric parser might accept it.
The text has the right shape but its value is zero. This contract requires a positive price.
